game_rules_brief.title: Canonical Sai Jong Dice rules for this match
rules: This is a 2-player, single-hand bluffing duel. Both players roll five private dice once; the first resolved challenge ends the whole match.
You see only `your_dice`. The opponent sees only their own dice. Do not reveal your exact dice in table talk unless you intentionally want to leak information.
Face order is 2 < 3 < 4 < 5 < 6 < 1. Face 1 is the highest face for bidding order.
Bids on faces 2-6 count actual matching dice plus all 1s as wild. A bid on face 1 counts only actual 1s.
There is no `natural` or no-wild bid mode in this match. Do not submit a natural parameter.
A bid must strictly beat the previous bid: raise quantity, or keep quantity and raise face by face order.
Challenge resolves immediately: if actual matching dice >= the bid quantity, the bid was true and the challenger loses; otherwise the bidder loses.
Optional `message` table talk is visible to the opponent, capped at 140 characters, and can bluff, bait, pressure, or mislead.
Treat `legal_actions`, `state`, and this brief as canonical over generic Liar's Dice assumptions.
